title: facade.list({prefix}) returns every key under a prefix with metadata shape intact
asA: developer maintaining a set of prefix-scoped feature flags
iWant: facade.list({prefix: flags/}) to return every key under the prefix with metadata shape
soThat: the applied project can enumerate a prefix-scoped collection through one seam

acceptanceCriteria.description: The list-with-prefix probe puts 10 keys under the prefix flags/ (each with a metadata blob) and calls facade.list({prefix: flags/}). The result returns all 10 keys, each entry carrying {name, metadata}, and every name preserves the domain-visible key. A decoy key outside the prefix is NOT included.
acceptanceCriteria.given: 10 keys put under a shared prefix through the facade plus one decoy outside the prefix
acceptanceCriteria.then: the result carries 10 entries with correct name and metadata fields; the decoy is absent; the aggregate probe verdict is pass

acceptanceCriteria.description: F-5 cursor pagination: with 20 keys under the prefix flags/ and facade.list({prefix:"flags/", limit:5}), the first call returns 5 entries and list_complete:false plus a cursor value. A follow-up facade.list({prefix:"flags/", limit:5, cursor:<value>}) returns the next 5 entries; four calls in total drain the 20 keys and the last call returns list_complete:true.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a facade with 20 keys put under the prefix flags/
acceptanceCriteria.when: facade.list({prefix, limit:5, cursor?}) is called four times threading the cursor
acceptanceCriteria.then: each of the first three calls returns 5 entries with list_complete:false and a cursor; the fourth returns 5 entries with list_complete:true

acceptanceCriteria.description: Empty-prefix list: facade.list({prefix:""}) on a driver with 3 keys returns all 3 entries; the empty prefix is a valid input meaning "match all keys". The returned entry names preserve the storage-side keys verbatim.
acceptanceCriteria.then: the result carries all 3 entries with the storage-side names

acceptanceCriteria.description: No-match list: facade.list({prefix:"missing/"}) on a driver where no key carries the prefix returns {keys:[], list_complete:true}. The kvHit or kvMiss vocabulary does not apply to list; the sink emits no per-entry record.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a facade with no keys carrying the prefix "missing/"
acceptanceCriteria.then: the result is {keys:[], list_complete:true}; the sink emits no per-entry records

acceptanceCriteria.description: list_complete indicator on the last page: the final page of a paginated list carries list_complete:true (and no cursor); every non-final page carries list_complete:false plus a cursor. A caller that iterates until list_complete:true always drains the collection.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a facade with 6 keys under the prefix flags/ and limit:5
acceptanceCriteria.when: facade.list({prefix, limit:5, cursor?}) drains the collection
acceptanceCriteria.then: the first page carries list_complete:false plus a cursor; the second page carries list_complete:true and no cursor
